A1.quote: sets el.hidden = false but never moves focus into the dialog, never traps it, and has no Escape handler

A2.quote: No tabindex, no role, no aria-expanded, no aria-haspopup, no keydown handling. A keyboard-only user cannot even focus the trigger — Tab skips straight over it — and a screen reader has nothing to announce

A3.quote: the 5-minute hold in checkout.js has no warning before expiry and no way to extend it

A4.quote: app.css:154-156 sets .slot-list button:focus { outline: none; } with no :focus-visible replacement

A5.quote: Availability indicator on clinician cards is color-only with no text alternative ... Screen readers get nothing (no name at all)

A6.quote: the input has no aria-invalid="true" and no aria-describedby pointing at the error text, so a screen reader landing on the field via .focus() won't necessarily read why it's invalid

A8.quote: main.js:40-65 swaps #view's contents on every hash change but never calls .focus() on anything ... focus silently drops to <body> and they have to re-explore the page from scratch at every step

A9.quote: Health-tips carousel auto-advances forever with no way to stop it ... Fix: add a visible pause/stop control (and ideally respect prefers-reduced-motion)

A10.quote: toasts auto-dismiss after 2s with no close/replay affordance ... If a user looks away for two seconds they lose the only explanation for why their selection was cleared

A11.quote: tabindex="1" on the search input is a positive-tabindex anti-pattern that reorders the tab sequence independent of visual/DOM order

DA2.quote: Confirmation page (confirmation.js:13,29) correctly moves focus to a tabindex="-1" heading — this is the pattern the other three views should copy.

DA3.quote: the buttons in slots.js:26-43 carry no .btn class, so they never get the :focus-visible ring defined at app.css:70-72 either

grade.first_issue: A8 (route/view changes never move focus to the new view)
